purpose: First complete construction of one calibration record; no population B verdict.

selection.rule: lexicographically first state in the already frozen calibration-0 capture plan

ordered_gates: complete and audit the entire 300-step source trajectory and all 24 snapshots
instantiate a prospective per-state compiler realization contract without executing a transition endpoint
run eager-1, compiled-1, eager-2, compiled-2 in fresh processes against that same contract
validate exact pre-state/coupling/realization identity and materialize paired U1/U2 effects
build one state-derived T1a bank twice and require exact content identity
evaluate T1a/T1b with transition-repeat r and evaluator-repeat e kept as separate levels
build and validate one arm-record plus paired-effect-record bundle

variance_separation.state_heterogeneity: not identifiable in this one-state pilot
variance_separation.trajectory_sampling_uncertainty: not estimated in this one-trajectory pilot

fail_closed: T1a frozen bank cannot be reproduced
post-state reconstruction or common evaluator repeat fails
nonclaims: state effect is not population B
runtime exactness is not general determinism
implementation-relative shift is not correctness error
one-step task shift is not long-run harm
whole-scorer treatment is not operator attribution
